CustomField.formula: HYPERLINK("https://www.google.es/maps/dir/" & IF(ISBLANK(Check_Out_Latitude__c), "0", TEXT(Check_Out_Latitude__c)) & "," & IF(ISBLANK(Check_Out_Longitude__c), "0", TEXT(Check_Out_Longitude__c)) & "/" & IF(ISBLANK(Check_Out_Latitude__c), "0", TEXT(Check_Out_Latitude__c)) & "," & IF(ISBLANK(Check_Out_Longitude__c), "0", TEXT(Check_Out_Longitude__c)), "Click On This URL")
CustomField.label: Check Out Location
